requirements.quote: apps/web: Notices page listing notices matched to the member's forums and matters with provenance and source links
and a matter-level 'affecting this matter' card

requirements.evidence: apps/web/__tests__/cross-tenant-actions.test.ts:122 (ACTIONS lists 'use server' exports only; the page and card are read-only and add none)

deliverables.change: New read services listWorkspaceNotices(tx, scope) and listMatterNotices(tx, scope, matterId): select notice_match joined to notice and source inside the given workspace tx, dedupe per notice, newest issuedOn first, bounded limit; return id,title,kind,issuedOn,effectiveOn,url,forumCodes,sourceName,recordedAt and the match reason; matter variant throws/NOT_FOUND for another workspace's matter like listRelevantJudgments
Export the two list functions and their types
Tests for the list functions (dedupe, order, matter filter, empty)
SERVICE_TESTS entries for listWorkspaceNotices and listMatterNotices
Real cases: B on A's matter is denied / sees nothing from A's notice_match; A unchanged
Server page: getWorkspaceContext, inWorkspace + listWorkspaceNotices via dynamic import; states loading/error/empty/denied; generateMetadata; dev ?__state preview like courts/page.tsx
Route error boundary with retry (copy courts/error.tsx)

List component: title, kind badge, issued/effective dates, forum codes, provenance line (source name, recorded date), external source link (target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer); exports a compact variant used by the matter card
Component tests: rows, provenance, source link attributes, empty state
Render an 'Affecting this matter' card slot fed by notices passed from the page
Load listMatterNotices in the member's scope (failure degrades to an empty card, never breaks the overview) and pass to MatterOverview
Add 'notices' to WORKSPACE_ROUTES and NAV_ITEMS (practice group, no permission), with an icon
Add 'notices' to SPIKE_ROUTES; adjust any other route-enumerating tests (sidebar-nav, mobile-nav, workspace-shell, placeholder-page map) as typecheck/tests dictate
New namespace: page title/intro/empty/error, kind labels, provenance and link text, matter card strings; mirror in ta and kn (packages/i18n/src/messages/{ta,kn}/notices.json)
Register the notices namespace; regenerate packages/i18n/src/generated/* and update translation-status.json (draft entries for ta/kn) with the repo's i18n generate script
Add 'notices' to the expected namespace list

preserve.what: packages/core/src/notices/poll.ts and match.ts behaviour and exports (#586) unchanged
Tenant isolation: notice_match is read only inside inWorkspace/withWorkspace for the member's workspace; no owner-role bypass, no new migration
apps/web/__tests__/cross-tenant-actions.test.ts ACTIONS stays equal to the exported 'use server' set (no action added)
Matter overview still renders when notices fail to load (apps/web/components/matters/matter-overview.tsx, matters/[id]/page.tsx)

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/i18n exec vitest run src/__tests__/catalog.test.ts src/__tests__/check-catalogs.test.ts

decisions.choice: Read-only core services in packages/core/src/notices/list.ts instead of querying tables from apps/web
decisions.justification: Web reads go through core in inWorkspace (apps/web/app/(app)/w/[slug]/matters/[id]/research/page.tsx:36-45); keeps RLS scope and the registry guard

decisions.choice: No server actions, so cross-tenant-actions.test.ts is unchanged; cross-tenant coverage comes from SERVICE_TESTS cases for the two list functions
No new workspace-package dependency and no migration
decisions.justification: notices domain already imports only db schema; core-domains.js:33 allows sources only and the list reads source via the db schema

decisions.choice: Add a 'notices' nav item and a new i18n namespace, mirroring how #593 added case-watch
decisions.justification: i18n registration pattern: packages/i18n/src/catalog.ts and __tests__/catalog.test.ts:85-125; nav: apps/web/lib/nav.ts:26-43
